name: account_num
label: Bank Account
description: Bank account number. Whitespaces are stripped.

name: bank_num
label: Sort Code
description: Sort code. Numerical code of the bank.

name: iban
label: IBAN
description: Bank account number in IBAN format.

name: bic
label: BIC/SWIFT
description: Bank BIC or SWIFT code.

name: const_sym
label: Constant Symbol
description: Statistical code on payment order.

name: spec_sym
label: Specific Symbol
description: Payee id on the payment order, or similar.

name: var_sym
label: Variable symbol
description: In some countries used by the supplier to match the payment received against the invoice. Possible non-numeric characters are stripped.

name: terms
label: Terms
description: Payment terms as written on the document (e.g. "45 days", "upon receipt").

name: payment_method
label: Payment method
description: [BETA] Payment method defined on a document (e.g. 'Cheque', 'Pay order', 'Before delivery')

name: customer_id
label: Customer Number
description: The number by which the customer is registered in the system of the supplier. Whitespaces are stripped.

name: date_due
label: Date Due
description: The due date of the invoice.

name: date_issue
label: Issue Date
description: Date of issue of the document.

name: date_uzp
label: Tax Point Date
description: The date of taxable event.

name: document_id
label: Document Identifier
description: Document number. Whitespaces are stripped.

name: order_id
label: Order Number
description: Purchase order identification (Order Numbers not captured as "sender_order_id"). Whitespaces are stripped.

name: recipient_address
label: Recipient Address
description: Address of the customer.

name: recipient_dic
label: Recipient Tax Number
description: Tax identification number of the customer. Whitespaces are stripped.

name: recipient_ic
label: Recipient Company ID
description: Company identification number of the customer. Possible non-numeric characters are stripped.

name: recipient_name
label: Recipient Name
description: Name of the customer.

name: recipient_vat_id
label: Recipient VAT Number
description: Customer VAT Number

name: recipient_delivery_name
label: Recipient Delivery Name
description: [BETA] Name of the recipient to whom the goods will be delivered.

name: recipient_delivery_address
label: Recipient Delivery Address
description: [BETA] Address of the reciepient where the goods will be delivered.

name: sender_address
label: Supplier Address
description: Address of the supplier.

name: sender_dic
label: Supplier Tax Number
description: Tax identification number of the supplier. Whitespaces are stripped.

name: sender_ic
label: Supplier Company ID
description: Business/organization identification number of the supplier. Possible non-numeric characters are stripped.

name: sender_name
label: Supplier Name
description: Name of the supplier.

name: sender_vat_id
label: Supplier VAT Number
description: VAT identification number of the supplier.

name: sender_email
label: Supplier Email
description: [BETA] Email of the sender.

name: sender_order_id
label: Supplier's Order ID
description: [BETA] Internal order ID in the suppliers system.

name: delivery_note_id
label: Delivery Note ID
description: [BETA] Delivery note ID defined on the invoice.

name: supply_place
label: Place of Supply
description: [BETA] Place of supply (the name of the city or state where the goods will be supplied).

name: currency
label: Currency
description: The currency which the invoice is to be paid in. Possible values: CZK, DKK, EUR, GBP, NOK, SEK, HUF, USD, AUD, INR, CHF, CNY, JPY, PLN, RON, RUB or other. May be also in lowercase.

name: document_type
label: Document Type
description: Possible values: credit_note, debit_note, tax_invoice (most typical), proforma, receipt, delivery_note, order or other.

name: language
label: Language
description: The language which the document was written in. Possible values: ces, deu, eng, fra, slk, esp, hun, swe, dan, fin, ital, nor, pol, por or other.

name: payment_method_type
label: Payment Method Type
description: Payment method used for the transaction. Possible values: card, cash.

name: amount_due
label: Amount Due
description: Final amount including tax to be paid after deducting all discounts and advances.

name: amount_rounding
label: Amount Rounding
description: Remainder after rounding amount_total.

name: amount_total
label: Total Amount
description: Subtotal over all items, including tax.

name: amount_paid
label: Amount paid
description: Amount paid already.

name: amount_total_base
label: Tax Base Total
description: Base amount for tax calculation.

name: amount_total_tax
label: Tax Total
description: Total tax amount.

name: tax_detail_base
label: Tax Base
description: Sum of tax bases for items with the same tax rate.

name: tax_detail_rate
label: Tax Rate
description: One of the tax rates in the tax breakdown.

name: tax_detail_tax
label: Tax Amount
description: Sum of taxes for items with the same tax rate.

name: tax_detail_total
label: Tax Total
description: Total amount including tax for all items with the same tax rate.

name: tax_detail_code
label: Tax Code
description: [BETA] Text on document describing tax code of the tax rate (e.g. 'GST', 'CGST', 'DPH', 'TVA'). If multiple tax rates belong to one tax code on the document, the tax code will be assigned only to the first tax rate. (in future such tax code will be distributed to all matching tax rates.)

name: table_column_code
label: Item Code/Id
description: Can be the SKU, EAN, a custom code (string of letters/numbers) or even just the line number.

name: table_column_description
label: Item Description
description: Line item description. Can be multi-line with details.

name: table_column_quantity
label: Item Quantity
description: Quantity of the item.

name: table_column_uom
label: Item Unit of Measure
description: Unit of measure of the item (kg, container, piece, gallon, ...).

name: table_column_rate
label: Item Rate
description: Tax rate for the line item.

name: table_column_tax
label: Item Tax
description: Tax amount for the line. Rule of thumb: tax = rate * amount_base.

name: table_column_amount_base
label: Amount Base
description: Unit price without tax. (This is the primary unit price extracted.)

name: table_column_amount
label: Amount
description: Unit price with tax. Rule of thumb: amount = amount_base + tax.

name: table_column_amount_total_base
label: Amount Total Base
description: The total amount to be paid for all the items excluding the tax. Rule of thumb: amount_total_base = amount_base * quantity.

name: table_column_amount_total
label: Amount Total
description: The total amount to be paid for all the items including the tax. Rule of thumb: amount_total = amount * quantity.

name: table_column_other
label: Other
description: Unrecognized data type.
